provenance: Operator-published coordinate document 'coordinates of the STPOS stations' (created 2026-05-12, header 'Etrf2000(Epoca 2008.0) - RDN'), Betreiber/Gestore column = STPOS. Only PILA and PRET live here: they are the two STPOS stations with neither a public mount on 62.101.0.40:2109 nor an M3G registration (the other roster gaps ride the sibling m3g endpoint). Coords are the document's DMS latitude/longitude converted to decimal; pdftotext scrambles the table's column alignment, so each DMS value was matched to its station via the known site locality (PILA = Piz La Ila/Alta Badia, PRET = Prettau/Predoi) rather than row order. The document's ECEF column is NOT trusted for these rows (row-shift produced a >0.2 deg error on a cross-checked station).
